description: Track new and lost backlinks/referring domains over time and classify link momentum, leakage, and volatility. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

date_from.description: Beginning of the requested reporting date range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Type: String. Format must match /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/. Optional; no client default.

date_to.description: End of the requested reporting date range in YYYY-MM-DD format; must not precede date_from. Type: String. Format must match /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/. Optional; no client default.

group_range.description: Calendar interval used to aggregate the new/lost backlink time series. Type: String. Accepted values: "day", "week", "month", "year". Default: "month".

include_subdomains.description: Include links or ranking data for subdomains of the target when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_backlinks_new_lost_timeseries
title: AgentSEO Backlinks New/Lost Timeseries
